stem:
Dev asks how many 2-digit counting numbers there are.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: There are $2$ such numbers, because a 2-digit number is itself called a digit pair.
There are $90$ such numbers: $10$ through $99$ each have digit length $2$.
The smallest 2-digit counting number is $10$ and the largest is $99$.
The same count also settles how many 3-digit numbers there are, with no further work.

teacher.key_rationale: 2-digit counting numbers run from 10 to 99, so there are 90 of them. A confuses digit length with the count. D over-extends the same count to 3-digit numbers.
